I am waiting for your prompt Reply. Regards! Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakaatuhu ! I am From Tablik Jamat , I want some information from your Fatwa Department, Our Masjid Maulana is Doing a some Amal, he is using a Got Had and leg for Amal ( Jadu tona ) this is Jayaz or not & He doing a Amal in one Room Alone with Gair Mahram this is Jayaz or Not He is Imam of our Masjeed , Please let me Know we can do the Namaz Behind him. I am waiting for your prompt Reply. Regards! Answer ID: 6491 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 809/743=L-1429 We do not know what he does with legs and head of goats and what amal he renders, albeit carrying out such acts with a non-Mahram in seclusion is unlawful and haram . It is undesirable to perform salah behind such Imam if he does not repent from these acts sincerely. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
